parts.label: (ii)
parts.answer: At convergence, $x=\pi+\tan^{-1}\!\left(\frac{1}{1-x}\right)$ rearranges to $\cot x=1-x$, so the limit is $\alpha$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
State a suitable equation, e.g. $x=\pi+\tan^{-1}(1/(1-x))$ without suffixes. B1
Rearrange this as $\cot x=1-x$, or commence working vice versa. B1
Total: 2
